rationale: High-volume SDP/Bronze clickstream with full instrumentation. correctness=5: PK + enums + nullability + good types throughout. completeness=5: owner + cadence + SLA + retention (by stream, including 90-day data retention appropriate for streaming) + product description. security=5: user_id and device_ip both classification=pii with explicit masking (hash_sha256, ip_truncate) and per-scope rules. governance=4: owner + classification + retention all set; not 5 because no explicit access policies for the multi-tenant data (tenant_id isolation is implicit, not declared as a policy). performance=5: clustering on (tenant_id, event_type) + hourly partition on event_ts — canonical layout for high-volume BigQuery. documentation=5: every column has a description; product-level description explains the SDP→Silver split.
